name: Sales (demo)
description: A shared set of business measures. Each is defined once; every report reads these, so a number means the same thing everywhere.

parameters.month_end: Last day of that month, YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.region: A region name, or NULL for the whole company

measures.name: Net revenue
measures.definition: Invoiced value in the month, after discounts and after returned goods are taken off. Counted on the invoice date. Freight and tax are not included.
measures.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM((qty - returned_qty) * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct)), 2)
FROM v_sales
WHERE invoice_month = :month
  AND (:region IS NULL OR region = :region)

measures.name: Gross margin %
measures.definition: Net revenue minus the standard cost of the goods that were kept, as a share of net revenue.
measures.sql:
SELECT ROUND(1.0 - SUM((qty - returned_qty) * unit_cost)
  / SUM((qty - returned_qty) * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct)), 4)
FROM v_sales
WHERE invoice_month = :month
  AND (:region IS NULL OR region = :region)

measures.name: On-time delivery %
measures.definition: Share of order lines shipped in the month that left on or before the date promised to the customer.
measures.sql:
SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(ship_date <= promised_date) / COUNT(*), 4)
FROM v_sales
WHERE ship_month = :month
  AND (:region IS NULL OR region = :region)

measures.name: Open orders
measures.definition: Value of order lines (after discount) that were ordered but not yet shipped at the end of the month.
measures.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct)), 2)
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_date <= :month_end
  AND (ship_date IS NULL OR ship_date > :month_end)
  AND (:region IS NULL OR region = :region)

alternatives.name: "Revenue" as orders booked
alternatives.definition: Orders entered in the month, at list price. Common in sales reports.
alternatives.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty * unit_price), 2)
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_month = :month

alternatives.name: "Revenue" as invoiced
alternatives.definition: Invoices dated in the month, after discount but before returns. Common in billing reports.
alternatives.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct)), 2)
FROM v_sales
WHERE invoice_month = :month
